AfterApplied.issue: The sim adds a guard C# does not have, and it changes the outcome. TangledPower.cs:23-30 afflicts EVERY Attack card with Entangled unconditionally -- there is no `Affliction == null` test, unlike its own AfterCardEnteredCombat at :34 and unlike Ringing's and Smoggy's AfterApplied -- so in the game Tangled OVERWRITES an existing affliction on Attack cards. powers.py:1781 adds `card.affliction is None`, so the sim skips already-afflicted Attacks and they cost nothing extra. DORMANT, RE-EXECUTED 2026-07-30: the record's own proposed trigger ('two ported enemy powers in one combat: Ringing... after which the game's Tangled re-afflicts') is UNREACHABLE with today's content, not merely unexercised -- checked by enumeration, not assumed. RingingPower's sole ported applier is `CeremonialBeast.take_turn` (monsters/overgrowth/ceremonial_beast.py:74-76); TangledPower's sole ported applier is `VineShambler.take_turn` (monsters/overgrowth/vine_shambler.py:44-45). `sts2_rl/rooms.py`'s Overgrowth act table lists `ceremonial_beast` only under `boss_keys` (:107) -- a solo, once-per-act, no-other-monster encounter (`CEREMONIAL_BEAST_BOSS = Encounter(monster_classes=[CeremonialBeast])`) -- and `vine_shambler` only under `normal_keys` (:104), itself a solo encounter (`VINE_SHAMBLER_NORMAL = Encounter(monster_classes=[VineShambler])`). A boss fight and a regular fight are never the same combat, so Ringing and Tangled cannot land on the same player's cards in the same fight. No other ported power widens this: enumerating every `CardCmd.afflict(` call site in powers.py (RingingAffliction, EntangledAffliction, SmogAffliction, TaintedAffliction, GalvanizedAffliction, HexedAffliction, BoundAffliction) finds no OTHER Overgrowth-act-1 applier that could co-occur inside VineShambler's own solo fight, which has no other monster in it to apply anything else. This is the exact shape the batch's calibration note warns about: a `live` claim drafted from the divergence's SHAPE rather than an enumeration of its real callers. Also note the sim's __init__ walk misses the Play pile for the same reason recorded on power/ringing and power/smoggy (player.py:100-103 vs PlayerCombatState.cs:70-80) -- unchanged, still dormant for the same reasons those records give.
